task_metadata.research_question: Design a molecular representation model for predicting chemical properties from molecular structure.
notes: Baselines map to D-MPNN, Uni-Mol, and GIN.
Tests cover BBBP, BACE, Tox21, ESOL, FreeSolv, and Lipophilicity.

tests.label: BBBP
tests.notes: Blood-brain barrier penetration benchmark from MoleculeNet and the original BBBP modeling paper.

tests.label: BACE
tests.notes: BACE benchmark linked to the assay paper used to ground the dataset plus MoleculeNet.

tests.label: Tox21
tests.notes: Tox21 challenge data and the MoleculeNet benchmark.

tests.label: ESOL
tests.notes: ESOL regression benchmark with the original aqueous solubility paper.

tests.label: FreeSolv
tests.notes: FreeSolv benchmark linked to the database update paper and MoleculeNet.

tests.label: Lipo
tests.notes: Lipophilicity is represented through the MoleculeNet benchmark paper.

baselines.name: dmpnn
baselines.notes: Directed message passing neural network baseline.

baselines.name: unimol
baselines.notes: Uni-Mol baseline with pretrained 3D molecular representation learning.

papers.title: Analyzing Learned Molecular Representations for Property Prediction
papers.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
papers.relevance: Introduces the directed message passing neural network used as the D-MPNN baseline.

papers.title: Uni-Mol: A Universal 3D Molecular Representation Learning Framework
papers.relevance: Introduces the 3D molecular Transformer baseline used in the task.

papers.title: How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?
papers.relevance: Canonical GIN baseline for graph-level prediction tasks.

papers.title: MoleculeNet: a benchmark for molecular machine learning
papers.relevance: Defines the standard benchmark suite that includes BBBP, BACE, Tox21, ESOL, FreeSolv, and Lipophilicity.

papers.title: A Bayesian approach to in silico blood-brain barrier penetration modeling
papers.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
papers.relevance: Original BBBP modeling paper behind the blood-brain barrier penetration benchmark.

papers.title: Biochemical and cell-based assays for characterization of BACE-1 inhibitors
papers.relevance: Experimental assay paper that motivates the BACE benchmark.

papers.title: The Tox21 robotic platform for the assessment of environmental chemicals--from vision to reality
papers.relevance: Tox21 challenge paper for the multi-task toxicity benchmark.

papers.title: ESOL: estimating aqueous solubility directly from molecular structure
papers.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Computer Sciences
papers.relevance: Original ESOL aqueous solubility benchmark paper.

papers.title: Approaches for calculating solvation free energies and enthalpies demonstrated with an update of the FreeSolv database
papers.venue: Journal of Chemical and Engineering Data
papers.relevance: Updated FreeSolv database paper used for the hydration free energy benchmark.

papers.title: Pushing the Boundaries of Molecular Representation for Drug Discovery with the Graph Attention Mechanism
papers.relevance: Graph-attention molecular property model that is directly relevant to the classification benchmarks in this task.
